I've turned the **What you need** list into a checklist. Each item now has a checkbox and a small icon: a laptop for Mac, a browser window for Chrome/Firefox, a hexagon for Node, and a robot for the coding agent. When the list scrolls into view, the boxes tick themselves green one by one, about half a second apart, and each icon lights up green as its box ticks. People whose system asks for less motion get the ticks without the animation.

I reloaded the page and checked it: all 4 items got their box and icon, all 4 ticked in turn, and the mod threw no errors. I also looked at a screenshot to confirm the layout. Your other mods on the page (neon title, stickers, typing tagline and the rest) still show as before.

To undo it, switch off **Need checklist** in the side panel.
